body.p: One tent. There is a string of sledges. There is a men's sledge. There is a domestic reindeer. A harnessed reindeer, too. The neighbour tent is large like a mountain. No sledge here. The story teller came into the tent of Kotianku. The story teller looks: there is only an old man and his old wife. There is a cradle. The wife, Kotianku, got up. (The story teller) came into the other tent. He looks: on the eastern side, on the bed, there are two people sitting. One old man and one old woman. Such a large bed, they take up all of it. On the other side, there are seven people sitting. They take up all the place. Kotianku, the old woman says: Ogre-old-man, you have brought up seven guys. So, where from is the moss, in wich you've brought them up? Where is the moss from? [Where is the place, you gather the moss from?] My child is freezing up without moss. Show it me, old man. The ogre says: hey-ho close by here. I'll show you. [You go this way] and see a stream. It will be shallow there. You cross the boiling flow place. While you are crossing the stream, your ropes (on boots) will go loose. You will find a tree stump. You will lean on the stump and tie a rope up. While you are tying up the rope, a raven will sit on your head. When a raven will sit, it will nod its head twice. It pecks your eyes out. As it pecks your eyes out, walk where you like. I told you all. Go now! Kotianku, the wife went to that land. Roles run behind her. She found the stream, there is a stream, a shallow place, it seems. She went on crossing that place. When crossing, the rope went loose. She leaned on the stump She started to tie the rope up. A raven sat on her head. The raven pecked twice. Kotianki, the old woman's eye got (pecked) out. Kotianku, the wife seemed to have died right then. What eyes will she move around now? Right then, did she die. The story teller of the tale went towards the tents. He reached the ogre's tent. The story teller went in. He sits for three days. While he had been sitting, Kotianku, the old woman came in. Ogre-old-man, you are wise. I will teach you. Eh, Ok, teach me. It became daytime. When you are sleeping, there will be a snow storm. A long snow storm. It will be a whole year long snow storm. You all won't go out. If the year is over and the summer comes, the snow storm will stop. You will be tired, of course, you will get outside when the snow storming is over. When you get outside, the whole land will be open to see. You will stretch up. Streching up, you become tents, huge like a tree. Both your hands will turn into bough. Kotianku, the old woman went home. So, there was a year-long snow storm. Even the tip of ones stretched out hand could not be seen. The year went over. The summer came, the snow storm stopped. The ogre went outside. Oh, the whole land is there to see. I am tired. He streches up. Streching up like this, he got as huge as a boat, he turned into a tree. The seven children went out. Hey - say the seven children - what a tree. A boat can be made. Let's make a boat. They took seven axes. They cut down the tree. They make a boat. Got to pick it out from the back. They make a Russian style boat. From the two hugh arms, the oars they made. Over there, across the river, the tents could be seen. We will go there, towards the tents to visit. Seven ogres travel in the boat. They travel seven long days. They are travelling in the boat for seven days. ??????? The boat got holes in it. The seven ogres drowned, when the boat has got a hole in it.
